pictures.observed: Straight narrow footbridge of pale birch roundwood: transverse small-log deck, round side stringers, upright birch posts, two longitudinal rails and diagonal branch braces. Real dark bark markings remain coarse shared texture or sparse geometry, not a private photo atlas. Both ends join gravel path on vegetated banks. Gentle deck camber and hidden supports approximate.
